comparisons.name: current-coherent-full
comparisons.method: Fresh shared source nomination, focused research and final publication over retained dated inputs.
comparisons.outcome: Substantive independent agenda/findings improved. Six focused investigations completed; two lost first synthesis at an internal phase cutoff with original time unused. Acquired sources survived. Public output still copied too many financial figures.

comparisons.name: current-coherent-completion-retry
comparisons.method: Retained actual acquisitions, fresh completion of the two interrupted subjects, then composition/review on the shared remaining-clock design.
comparisons.outcome: Both subjects produced retained findings and final publication completed; overview improved but expanded stories still transcribed financial line items.

comparisons.name: current-coherent-editor-contract
comparisons.method: Fresh writer/review with explicit public-field purposes and historical knowledge timing.
comparisons.outcome: Microsoft and Vertiv details became more selective, but the overview was still a long inventory and other stories still repeated financial figures. Process/capture language persisted. Rejected personally despite model reviewer revision/acceptance.

comparisons.name: recovery-coherent-current
comparisons.method: Recovered production evidence; fresh full Pro writing and review.
comparisons.outcome: Paid writing/review completed, but publication rejected a reader-prefixed bundle identity in the separate candidate triple. No feed was written. Overview improved, but Caterpillar/macro/Microsoft details remain numerical inventories.

comparisons.name: recovery-coherent-reader
comparisons.method: Same254original documents,88retained bundles and12company investigations. Fresh full Pro/high writing/review with originals available through the existing reader. Final metadata-only adapter reapplied the unchanged paid answer with all network prohibited.
improvements: Broader selection includes Fortinet,ADT,Marvell/Lumentum,consumer results,Glaukos and unresolved Iovance alongside the main five events.
One source identity connects existing research reading and publication;9primary research bundles retain their original public and underlying metadata.
The writer/reviewer both complete and the entire selected feed materializes without cropping.
remaining_quality_failures: Overview still reads as a long story inventory.
Expanded Caterpillar,Fortinet,Microsoft and macro fields still transcribe too many financial figures.
Repetitive framing and generic qualifications remain; Carvana/Chipotle are incorrectly called peers in a software story.
ServiceNow forward-expectations explanation remains stronger than the reconstructed missing guidance detail.
comparisons.model_review: Advisory revise corrected Microsoft report-date bookkeeping,Caterpillar conflicting consensus claims and Iovance source linkage. Personal review still rejects release.
comparisons.reader_limit: The reader was available; the model answered from retained findings without opening originals. This does not demonstrate useful navigation or prove context size caused the writing failure.

important_limits: Historical fixtures were dated04:06UTC, while shared acquisition read a subsequently populated current corpus. Timing/availability needs careful distinction; these are not clean historical backtests. No production feed was written from these outputs.
All compared core research/writing/review used the full Pro model. These failures do not establish that cheaper production models caused them.
Operational tests establish budget/clock/provenance behavior only.

prepared_fresh_comparison.method: Same completed-run source corpus and numerical observation dates. Fresh shared composition/review only, isolated local state, no production writes and no new acquisition. Compare all actual public fields; no curated excerpt or topic/number quota.

local_release_hold: No coherent-design image build or deployment: complete-output quality still does not meet owner requirements. Operational source improvements are committed separately from qualitative acceptance.

preview.content: Actual complete output with no prose editing; detailed fields are expandable. Candidate is held.
